incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD-INC-4123: prometheus.scrape_error_targets > 10 in eu-west-1 :rotating_light:
pagerbot: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-4123|PD-INC-4123> — paging @oncall-sre
Raj: Acked on PD. I'll take first responder.
Emma: Oncall rotation note: Raj is primary until 17:45 UTC. ping me if escalation needed.
Raj: quick lookup — alertgroup shows a spike starting ~16:47 UTC. Most failures are from prometheus-scraper -> node-exporter endpoints. No other infra alerts yet.
Maria: I can see scrape failures in Prometheus targets page — lots of 503s for node-exporter on the eu-west-1 k8s nodes. Also fluentd is showing higher output queue size to kafka. Could be a common network flake.
Raj: pulling logs from scraper pods now:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=prometheus-scraper -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring logs prometheus-scraper-7f6b9 -c scraper | tail -n 120\```
Dan: Output from the scraper shows TLS handshake timeouts to some node-exporter endpoints and `read tcp: connection reset by peer` on a subset of nodes.
Oliver: kafka topic `logs-ingest` consumer group lag: ~1.2M messages (primarily from eu-west-1). Fluentd forwarder spike at ~300k pending.
Maria: grabbing fluentd pods logs:
```bash
kubectl -n logging logs fluentd-kafka-2 -c fluentd | egrep "WARN|ERROR" | tail -n 80
# shows connection timed out to kafka.bootstrap:9092 and repeated retries\```
Raj: Quick assessment — two correlated symptoms: 1) Prometheus scrapes failing to node-exporter, 2) Fluentd cannot push to kafka — both look like networking between worker nodes and kafka/broker endpoints. Possible network policy or BGP flapping?
Emma: Any customer-facing impact?
Raj: No direct API 5xxs reported. This looks like observability backend degraded. However, some alerting depends on these metrics so we have noise and risk of missed alerting if this continues.
Maria: Immediate mitigations I can run: 1) restart a subset of node-exporter daemonset pods on nodes reporting 503s, 2) scale prometheus-scraper replicas from 3 -> 6 to spread load, 3) restart fluentd forwarders to re-establish kafka connections.
Dan: +1. Also create an Alertmanager silence for the noisy scrape_error_targets alerts for 45m so we don't cascade pages while we fix underlying network. I can create the silence and comment with ID.
Raj: I'm going to restart node-exporter on 3 affected nodes (rolling).
Maria: Doing restarts now.
Raj: Restart commands run:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart daemonset/node-exporter
# monitoring output: rolling restart started for nodes: eu-west-1a,b,c\```
(1 minute later)
Maria: restarted node-exporter on eu-west-1b and 1c — flaky nodes show INIT probes failing then recover.
Oliver: kafka broker network connections show transient increase in retransmits. Ops-net team pinged (ticket NET-987). They replied: "we're seeing a router eBGP flap impacting eu-west-1 pod networking, isolating now."
Dan: Silence created in Alertmanager: silence ID `s-83f2` for `prometheus.scrape_error_targets` in eu-west-1 for 45m.
pagerbot: Alertmanager silence created: <https://alertmanager.company/silences/s-83f2|s-83f2> by Dan
Raj: After the node-exporter restarts, Prometheus target scrape success went from ~60% -> ~98% for the previously affected nodes. Fluentd still shows backlog but Kafka connection errors are less frequent.
Maria: I'm scaling scraper deployment now to soak traffic while NET team fully heals.
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy prometheus-scraper --replicas=6\```
(10 minutes later)
Oliver: NET team confirms BGP stabilization at 17:05 UTC. Packet loss dropped to baseline.
Raj: Fluentd backlog draining — consumer lag decreased from 1.2M -> 120k in 20m.
Emma: Good. Can someone do a short customer impact note? I want to capture for postmortem whether any customer alerting or SLA was affected.
Maria: Customer impact: none reported. No API 5xxs, no increased latency in inference path. Observability gap lasted ~18 minutes before we started rolling restarts, with degraded scrapes up to ~45m in total for some nodes. Will add to postmortem.
Dan: I'll open an incident in `/incidents` with timeline and mitigation steps, link PD incident and Alertmanager silence.
Raj: Handoff — my oncall shift ends in 40m. Handoff to Emma and then Maria will be point for followups.
Emma: Thanks. Maria — can you keep an eye on fluentd backlog over next 2 hours and coordinate with NET-987? If it resurges, escalate to SE network lead.
Maria: Will do. Creating follow-up ticket: LOG-452 with backlog metrics and steps taken.
(1 hour later)
incident-bot: PD-INC-4123 status changed -> Resolved by Raj.
pagerbot: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-4123|PD-INC-4123> — closed.
Raj: closing thread — will add final notes to incident doc in `/incidents/PD-INC-4123` and link here.
Emma: Thanks everyone for quick coord. Postmortem assigned to Raj+Maria.
Maria: leaving logs and commands in the incident doc.
incident-bot: Thread archived and incident marked for postmortem review.
